channel.description: Latest articles from European Medical Journal (emjreviews.com)

item.title: Mobile Instant Messaging for Smoking Cessation Falls Short
item.description: A mobile instant messaging exercise-program did not significantly improve lab-verified smoking-cessation overall rates at 6 months. The post Mobile Instant Messaging for Smoking Cessation Falls Short appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Scientists Find Lab Test Can Explain High Vitamin B12
item.description: Macro B12 may explain persistently raised vitamin B12 levels and help avoid unnecessary bone marrow biopsy in patients with low suspicion of malignancy. The post Scientists Find Lab Test Can Explain High Vitamin B12 appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Five Year Outcomes of Ublituximab in Multiple Sclerosis
item.description: Long-term ublituximab treatment reduces relapse rates and disability progression, reinforcing early intervention strategies in multiple sclerosis care. The post Five Year Outcomes of Ublituximab in Multiple Sclerosis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Leuprolide Tied to More Coronary Plaque in Prostate Cancer Progression
item.description: Randomised data show leuprolide is linked to greater 12-month coronary plaque progression than relugolix in men receiving ADT for prostate cancer. The post Leuprolide Tied to More Coronary Plaque in Prostate Cancer Progression appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI Matches Experts in Diagnosing Early Gastric Cancer
item.description: Deep learning models have matched the diagnostic accuracy of expert endoscopists in detecting early gastric cancer. The post AI Matches Experts in Diagnosing Early Gastric Cancer appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: “The Best Medicine is Peace”: Ukraine Healthcare Attacks Up One-Fifth
item.description: Ukraine experienced a surge in healthcare attacks by nearly 20% in 2025 compared with 2024, WHO reports. The post “The Best Medicine is Peace”: Ukraine Healthcare Attacks Up One-Fifth appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Weight Loss Surgery Healthier for the Heart than GLP-1s
item.description: Metabolic and bariatric surgery offers greater cardiovascular protection than GLP-1 receptor agonists, a 2026 systematic review and meta-analysis has found. The post Weight Loss Surgery Healthier for the Heart than GLP-1s appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Cognitive Impairment and Physical Decline in Haemodialysis Patients
item.description: Study finds high rates of cognitive impairment in haemodialysis patients, with poorer physical function seen in those with established cognitive decline. The post Cognitive Impairment and Physical Decline in Haemodialysis Patients appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Preprocedural Vascular Sheath Insertion Cuts PCI Mortality
item.description: Mortality occurred in 4.5% of patients in the sheath group versus 18.2% in the non-sheath group. Neurological outcomes also favoured preprocedural vascular sheath insertion. The post Preprocedural Vascular Sheath Insertion Cuts PCI Mortality appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: UCB and Refold Therapeutics strike amyloidosis deal
item.description: UCB backs Refold Therapeutics to tackle light chain amyloidosis, a rare disease damaging the heart and kidneys. The post UCB and Refold Therapeutics strike amyloidosis deal appeared first on European Medical Journal.
